problem: The production runtime and GitHub SQL were functionally identical, but Supabase migration history registered the one-loop migration as version 20261005144606 while the repository filename used 20261005161500.
root_cause: The production DDL was applied through the Supabase migration API before the repository migration artifact was canonicalized, so the runtime received a server-generated migration version that did not match the later GitHub filename.
prevention: Migration identity is part of production parity; repository filename/version must match the applied Supabase migration version when the SQL and migration name are identical.
Never reapply an already-live idempotent migration just to repair history when production definitions and post-merge readback already match.
Repair repository migration identity by renaming the canonical migration artifact to the exact applied production version.
Keep exact-HEAD checks, merge and post-merge production readback as the terminal closure chain.
